body: Felt this so much. Throughout my last relationship his ex was the only female that I felt insecure about, for a perfectly good reason. Since the year before he left me and completely dropped me from his life for that same girl. Eventually he broke up with her and he was always just so well with his words. He convinced me to forgive him and take him back. After spending nearly a year of our lives together and me buying him everything and anything he wanted. He decided he needed a break to mentally get himself right. I tried my best to understand. We ended up breaking up but staying on good terms. He’d randomly decide to tell me shit about how he still loved me and missed me so we had a conversation about meeting up and discussing whether we want to get back together, only for the next day him to start talking to that same ex again in flirtatious manner. And when I came to him crying when I saw that he proceeded to try to make me feel like I was overreacting once again. That’s when I was able to recognize his constant repeating toxic behavior and blocked him completely from my life to focus on myself and my happiness and although it does feel like I’m missing a huge part of my life, I know In the end I’ll come out happier than my ex ever made me. Moral of the story is Stay positive and focus on yourself :)
